parsed.production_notes: The video features human actors in a realistic setting with natural lighting and camera work. There are no signs of AI-generated visuals in the live-action segments.
parsed.interaction_pattern: Testimonial and product demonstration; a satisfied user explains the app's benefits to a skeptical friend, showing how the AI provides live correction of grammar mistakes.
parsed.audio_track: Spoken dialogue in both English and Malayalam between characters. There is no background music or song.

characters.appearance: A middle-aged South Indian man in his late 40s or early 50s with a medium build and a dark complexion. He has short, neat black hair and a prominent, well-groomed black mustache. He has a friendly and confident face with warm eyes.
characters.wardrobe: A short-sleeved, button-down shirt in a solid beige/khaki color, paired with a traditional white mundu (dhoti) with a thin gold border (kasavu).

characters.appearance: A young Caucasian man in his late 20s or early 30s with a slim, athletic build and a fair complexion. He has short, light brown hair and is clean-shaven. He has a curious and open facial expression.
characters.wardrobe: A plain, dark green crew-neck t-shirt, light beige or khaki trousers, and a black backpack worn over both shoulders.

characters.appearance: A middle-aged South Indian man in his 40s with a medium build and a dark complexion. He has short black hair and a neatly trimmed full beard and mustache that are starting to show some grey. He has expressive, inquisitive eyes.
characters.wardrobe: A short-sleeved, button-down shirt in a light cream or off-white color, paired with a traditional white mundu (dhoti) with a thin gold border.

scenes.setting: A rustic, traditional South Indian tea shop with weathered green walls. A red and white sign reads 'TEA SHOP'. Shelves with glass jars of snacks are in the background.
scenes.camera: Medium close-up, cutting back and forth between characters.

panels.panel_visual_description: The scene alternates between two shots. In one, Character B, a young Caucasian man with a backpack, sits on a wooden bench against a green wall, looking up and speaking with a friendly expression. In the other, Character A, a middle-aged Indian man with a mustache, stands behind a counter in his tea shop, smiling warmly as he responds. He holds two small glasses of tea on a saucer.

scenes.visual_description: Quick cuts between Character B, a foreign tourist, sitting in a tea shop, and Character A, the shop owner, behind the counter. They have a conversation in English. Large, stylized on-screen text captions their dialogue.
scenes.audio_transcript:
Character B says: One chai please?
Character A says: Normal chai or ginger chai?
Character B says: Ginger chai? Normal chai!
Character A says: Would you like some banana fritters with it?
Character B says: Yeah, I will give it a try.
scenes.on_screen_text:
ONE CHAI PLEASE?
NORMAL CHAI OR GINGER CHAI?
GINGER CHAI? NORMAL CHAI!!
WOULD YOU LIKE SOME BANANA FRITTERS WITH IT?
I WILL GIVE IT A TRY

scenes.setting: The same tea shop. Character C is seated on a bench.
scenes.camera: Medium shot, cutting between Character C and Character A.

panels.panel_visual_description: The scene cuts between a medium shot of Character C, a bearded man, sitting on a bench and looking up with an amazed expression as he speaks, and a medium close-up of Character A, the shop owner, listening and then replying with a smile.

scenes.visual_description: Character C, another customer, asks Character A in Malayalam how he speaks English so well. Character A replies modestly. Large on-screen text captions their dialogue.
scenes.audio_transcript:
Character C says: രവിയേ! എങ്ങനെയാടാ ഇത്രേം നന്നായി ഇംഗ്ലീഷ് സംസാരിക്കുന്നെ? എവിടെ പോയി പഠിച്ചു? [Raviye! Engane da ithrem nannaayi English samsaarikkunne? Evide poyi padichu? - Ravi! How do you speak English so well? Where did you go to study?]
Character A says: പഠിക്കാൻ എവിടേക്കും പോയിട്ടില്ല ചേട്ടാ. [Padikkaan evidekkum pooyilla chetta. - I didn't go anywhere to study, brother.]
scenes.on_screen_text:
RAVIYE! ENGANE DA ITHREM NANNAAYI ENGLISH SAMSAARIKUNNE? EVIDE POYI PADICH?
PADIKKAAN EVIDEKKUM POOYILLA CHETTA.

scenes.setting: The tea shop, with a cut to a screencast of a mobile app.
scenes.camera: Medium close-up on Character A, followed by a screen recording.

panels.panel_visual_description: Character A stands in his tea shop, smiling confidently. The shot then transitions to a clean, bright screen recording of a mobile application interface. The interface shows a small, friendly robot avatar, progress bars for 'Lessons completed' and 'Fluency Score', and a grid of learning modules with icons and titles like 'Talk about anything' and 'Daily routine'.

scenes.visual_description: Character A reveals he uses the MySivi app. The app's logo appears, followed by a screencast of the app's dashboard. He explains it's an AI English trainer that can be used anywhere, anytime. On-screen text captions his speech.
scenes.audio_transcript: Character A says: MySivi ആപ്പ് ഒരു AI ഇംഗ്ലീഷ് ട്രെയ്നർ ആണ്. എവിടെ വേണേലും എപ്പോ വേണേലും പഠിക്കാം. ചായക്കടയിൽ നിന്ന് പോലും. [MySivi app oru AI English trainer aanu. Evide venelum epo venelum padikkaam. Chaayakadayil ninnu polum. - The MySivi app is an AI English trainer. You can study wherever you want, whenever you want. Even from the tea shop.]
scenes.on_screen_text:
MySivi
ORU AI ENGLISH TRAINER AANU.
EVIDE VENELUM, EPO VENELUM PADIKAAM.
CHAAYA KADENU NINNU POLUM.

scenes.camera: Medium shot, cutting between Character C and Character A.

panels.panel_visual_description: Character C sits on the bench, looking up and asking a skeptical question with an inquisitive expression. The shot cuts to Character A, who smiles knowingly and begins to explain, gesturing with his hands.

scenes.visual_description: Character C questions the AI, assuming it only teaches in English. Character A reassures him, explaining that the app's highlight is that it teaches in Malayalam. On-screen text captions the dialogue.
scenes.audio_transcript:
Character C says: എഐ-യോ? അത് ഇംഗ്ലീഷിൽ അല്ലേ പഠിപ്പിക്കുക? നീ എങ്ങനെ മനസ്സിലാക്കി? [AI-yo? Athu English-il alle padipikka? Nee engane manasilaakki? - AI? Doesn't it teach in English? How did you understand?]
Character A says: അതാണ് ഹൈലൈറ്റ്. മലയാളത്തിൽ തന്നെ പഠിപ്പിക്കും! [Athāṇ highlight. Malayāḷattil tanne paṭhippikkuṁ! - That's the highlight. It teaches in Malayalam itself!]
scenes.on_screen_text:
AI-YO? ATHU ENGLISH-IL ALLE PADAPIKA? NEE ENGANE MANASILAAKKI?
ATHAANU HIGHLIGHT. MALAYALATHIL THANNE PADAPIKKUM!

scenes.setting: The tea shop, with an animated app UI overlay.

panels.panel_visual_description: Character A stands in his tea shop, speaking directly to the viewer with a reassuring and friendly expression. He explains the benefits of the app, emphasizing its non-judgmental nature.

scenes.visual_description: As Character A explains that the app doesn't judge or make fun of mistakes, an animated overlay of a chat interface appears. It shows the AI asking a question, the user making a grammatical error ('I go to the beach...'), and the AI providing a gentle correction ('Almost perfect! ... I went to the beach...').
scenes.audio_transcript: Character A says: ആരും ജഡ്ജ് ചെയ്യില്ല, കളിയാക്കില്ല. തെറ്റിച്ചാലും ടെൻഷൻ ഇല്ല! ക്ഷമയോടെ AI പറഞ്ഞു മനസ്സിലാക്കി തരും. [Aarum judge cheyyilla, kaliyaakila. Thettichaalum tension illa! Kshamayode AI paranju manasilaakki tharum. - No one will judge, no one will make fun. Even if you make a mistake, there's no tension! The AI will patiently explain and make you understand.]
scenes.on_screen_text:
AARUM JUDGE CHEYYILLA, KALIYAAKILA.
THETTICHAALUM TENSION ILLA!
KSHAMA YODE AI PARANJU MANASILAAKI THARUM.

scenes.camera: Cuts between characters, with a 3D graphic overlay.

panels.panel_visual_description: Character C looks concerned about the price. The shot cuts to Character A, who smiles and points down at the two glasses of tea on his counter, explaining that the app costs less. The background blurs as he speaks.

scenes.visual_description: Character C asks if the app is expensive. Character A says it costs less than a cup of tea. A large, red and white 3D graphic of '₹ 3' floats in the center of the screen over a blurred shot of Character A. He then clarifies that this price is for a trial of the full app.
scenes.audio_transcript:
Character C says: അപ്പൊ നല്ല പൈസ ആവും അല്ലേ? [Appo nalla paisa aavum ale? - Then it must cost a lot of money, right?]
Character A says: ഈ ചായേടെ വില പോലും ഇല്ല! ട്രയൽ വേർഷന് വെറും മൂന്നു രൂപ മാത്രമേ ഉള്ളൂ. ഫുൾ ആപ്പ് ട്രൈ ചെയ്യാം. [Ee chaayede vila polum illa! Trial version-u verum moonnu roopa maathre ullu. Full app try cheyyaam. - It doesn't even cost as much as this tea! The trial version is only three rupees. You can try the full app.]
scenes.on_screen_text:
APPO NALLA PAISA AAVUM ALE?
EE CHAAYEDE VILA POLUM ILLA!
₹ 3
FULL APP TRY CHEYYAAM.

scenes.camera: Medium close-up on Character A, with a 3D graphic overlay.

panels.panel_visual_description: Character A stands in his shop, speaking persuasively with open hands. The background blurs as he mentions the number of users. He then smiles warmly, sharing how his own business has improved.

scenes.visual_description: Character A provides social proof, stating that over 50 lakh people use the app. A large, golden 3D graphic of '50 LAKHS' appears on screen. He concludes by saying his own business has improved as a result.
scenes.audio_transcript: Character A says: ഇപ്പോത്തന്നെ 50 ലക്ഷത്തിൽ അധികം ആളുകൾ MySivi ആപ്പിൽ നിന്നും ഇംഗ്ലീഷ് പഠിച്ചിട്ടുണ്ട്. എൻ്റെ കച്ചോടം അതുകൊണ്ട് മെച്ചപ്പെട്ടിട്ടേ ഉള്ളൂ. [Ippo thanne 50 lakshathil adikam aalukal MySivi app il ninnum English padichittund. Ente kachodam athond mechappettitte ullu. - Right now, more than 50 lakh people have learned English from the MySivi app. My business has only improved because of it.]
scenes.on_screen_text:
50 LAKHS
AALUKAL MYSIVI APP IL NINNUM ENGLISH PADICHITTUND.
ENTE KACHODAM ATHOND MECHAPETTITE ULLU.
